title: Band Timestep Scheduler（频带时间步调度器）

standard.summary: （实验性）基于小波分析的自适应时间步采样器：对每个训练样本动态计算其高/低频能量，并据此调整时间步采样分布，使高频细节丰富的图像获得更多高频对应的噪声步训练。
standard.effect: 对高频丰富的图像（纹理细腻）增加高噪声步的采样概率，让模型为该图像多学习细节方向的去噪；低频主导的图像（大色块）多采样低噪声步。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集高频/低频内容差异较大时（如同时包含线稿和照片）可以尝试，让训练自适应图像内容。实验性功能。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。内容均匀的数据集（全是同风格图像）使用意义不大。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) An adaptive timestep sampler built on wavelet analysis: it measures each training sample's high- and low-frequency energy on the fly and shifts the timestep distribution so that images rich in high-frequency detail get more of the noise steps that correspond to it.
standard_en.effect: Images rich in high frequency (fine texture) get a higher chance of high-noise steps, so the model spends more of that image's training on detail-side denoising; images dominated by low frequency (large flat areas) draw more low-noise steps.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth trying when the dataset's high- and low-frequency content varies a lot (line art and photographs in one set, say), so the run adapts to image content. An experimental feature.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. There is little point on a uniform dataset (all images in one style).

advanced.principle: 对每张图像的 latent 做 DCT/小波变换，计算高频能量 E_high 和低频能量 E_low，以此调制时间步采样的偏置（类似 P2 weighting 但基于内容感知而非全局统计）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 每步额外的小波计算增加约 3~8% 的训练开销；对于 GPU-bound 训练此额外开销相对不明显。

advanced_en.principle: Applies a DCT/wavelet transform to each image's latent and computes high-frequency energy E_high vs low-frequency energy E_low, using them to bias timestep sampling (like P2 weighting but content-aware rather than global statistics).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The extra wavelet computation per step adds roughly 3~8% training overhead; relatively imperceptible for GPU-bound training.
